rules: One row per component_inventory_v3_1.json component (224 Python components, then the 3 non-Python execution paths), ids and order identical; rows are added or removed only by a new inventory version.
migration_class, classification_confidence, classification_confidence_v3_1, port_disposition and simulation_completion_wp mirror the inventory row.

A row changes only on admission evidence: each status change is a programme_v3_1 lifecycle transition, appended to the row's status_history as {from, to, date, evidence: [paths], history_entry}, and recorded in docs/HISTORY.md. A status that differs from the inventory baseline without such an entry is invalid.
contract is null until a parity contract (template v3_1) is committed; then {path, id, sha256} and status PREREG_PARITY.
admission_evidence is null until admission; a row or partial admission with status ADMITTED (or PYTHON_RETIRED_FROM_ACTIVE) must name an admission-evidence path that exists, with its sha256.
authoritative_implementation: kind python (the Python reference paths), rust (crate and paths) or retired; it becomes rust only with ADMITTED.
Statuses use component_inventory_v3_1.json status_vocabulary; new items use new_item_status_vocabulary.
Lanes put requested changes in their parity / acceptance report (ledger_update_requested); the ledger owner applies them with the evidence.
